1.title: Haitian Workers Keep Key West Tourism Afloat. Now They’re Disappearing.
1.summary: The end of legal protections for Haitian immigrants nationally has jolted the labor market in Key West, a remote vacation destination where many live and work.

2.title: A Teen Autopsy Marks the Arrival of a Deadly Drug in San Francisco
2.summary: City officials — and one determined mother — are working to stop the spread of cychlorphine, which is far more potent than fentanyl.

3.title: As Supreme Court Weighs Trump Mail Ballot Plan, Another Judge Blocks It
3.summary: The ruling delivered another blow to the plan with a looming Supreme Court decision that could determine whether it goes into effect before the midterm election.

4.title: Saudi Arabia Faces ‘Worst-Case Scenario’ After Iran’s Attacks and Trump’s Rebuffs
4.summary: The kingdom is in a state of strategic shock after coming under attack from an emboldened Iran and failing to win more U.S. military support, analysts say.

5.title: The New Moscow: A Digital Utopia Doubling as a Surveillance Trap
5.summary: Cutting-edge technologies have reshaped the Russian capital, making it safer, more convenient — and more closely watched.

6.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Africa in search of a mate
6.summary: Scientists say the record-breaking journey by three brothers offers hope wildlife can survive growing pressures.
